name: general-chrome-console-bridge-v4
description: Bridge-tab Chrome console bridge with browser-local queues and multi-worker execution.

scripts.build: npm run build:canary && npm run build:chrome
scripts.build:canary: BRIDGE_PORT=4471 BRIDGE_INSTANCE=canary BRIDGE_BROWSER_LABEL='Google Chrome Canary' BRIDGE_EXTENSION_NAME='General Chrome Console Bridge v4 Canary' BRIDGE_EXTENSION_DESCRIPTION='Canary bridge with automatic queue routing on http://127.0.0.1:4471.' DIST_DIR=dist-canary node ./scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:chrome: BRIDGE_PORT=4472 BRIDGE_INSTANCE=chrome BRIDGE_BROWSER_LABEL='Google Chrome' BRIDGE_EXTENSION_NAME='General Chrome Console Bridge v4 Chrome' BRIDGE_EXTENSION_DESCRIPTION='Chrome bridge with automatic queue routing on http://127.0.0.1:4472.' DIST_DIR=dist-chrome node ./scripts/build.mjs
scripts.build:generic: BRIDGE_INSTANCE=v4 BRIDGE_BROWSER_LABEL='General Chrome Console Bridge v4' BRIDGE_EXTENSION_NAME='General Chrome Console Bridge v4' BRIDGE_EXTENSION_DESCRIPTION='Browser-local queue bridge with multi-worker tab execution.' DIST_DIR=dist node ./scripts/build.mjs
